def register_custom_colormaps():
    """
    registers custom color maps
    """
    from .colormaps import register_colormap
    from .colormaps import get_colormap
    from .colormaps import get_colormaps

    # load custom color maps
    custom_colormaps = get_colormaps()

    # register custom color maps
    for colormap_name in custom_colormaps:
        register_colormap(colormap_name, custom_colormaps[colormap_name])

    # set default colormap
    default_colormap = get_colormap("custom_colormap_0")
    register_colormap("default", default_colormap)

    # set default colormap for plotly
    default_plotly_colormap = get_colormap("custom_colormap_1")
    register_colormap("default_plotly", default_plotly_colormap)
